integrity: Six branch weights and all intervention probabilities explicitly specified; exact rational computations independently verified by exhaustive survivor-set summation; universal smaller-tree result proved symbolically, not computationally inferred.
scientific_limitations: Positive rooted branch lengths; independently surviving taxa; equal-cost discrete interventions; no root stem; no statement for continuous spending, empirical extinction rates or correlated survival. Hartmann and Steel (2006) established broader generic greedy failure on a four-taxon example with unequal baseline risks. The equal-baseline distinction has residual historical-priority risk.
title: Homogeneous extinction risk does not guarantee greedy conservation priority: the sharp four-taxon boundary
